newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end with pared losses, banks bought.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end with pared losses, banks bought.

text.p: Thai stocks pared losses on Friday as buying of select bank and finance stocks ahead of unaudited six month results expected later this month helped support a fundamentally weak market, traders said.
The SET Index pared earlier losses to end 2.91 points or 0.44 percent lower at 653.37. The SET 50 shed 0.30 points or 0.60 percent to 49.38 in trade worth 5.66 billion baht.
"Some investors were speculatively buying in some major bank issues ahead of the announcement of their earning results (in the first half," said an analyst at United Securities.
